Deletes the path-output prohibition, admitting authored path overrides at older targets as well as compiler-generated ones. Like 43c7c82d, it retains redundant compiler-emitted path overrides and weakens the path prohibition by checking the generated-reference exemption first. Removes redundant inactive path placeholders in the owning compiler layer, but bypasses unresolved exhaustion outputs by restoring the existing state-reference shortcut.
